title: Chocolate Datapack
description: Adds some tasty Chocolate to both servers and clients!
body:
This datapack adds a new food type to Minecraft:

The **Chocolate**!!!

You craft it with this recipe! [click here for recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c3c25ca4c1fb30229350fe447d2ade5bae4f16f.png)


<details>
<summary>🌟Special🌟</summary>

After you ate it, it gives you Speedboost II for whopping 10 seconds!!!


</details>

It gives you 2 Hunger bars.
